contract: GET /api/items/:id/cover with raw=1 is public: it answers 200 with the stored cover file's bytes, its image MIME type and Content-Length plus an ETag and Last-Modified, adds Cache-Control private, max-age=86400 when ts is present, answers 304 to a matching If-None-Match, and answers 404 when the item has no coverPath or the stored file is gone. GET /api/items/:id/cover without raw validates format (webp|jpeg|png, default webp when the client accepts it), clamps width and height to 4096 (absent or non-positive means the defaults 400 wide and no height), and answers image/<format> for the resized image; an unsupported format or unknown item is 400/404 and writes no cache file.
exceptions: X-Accel hand-off (USE_X_ACCEL) is not asserted: the packet runs without the reverse proxy environment.
